scripts.typecheck: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && astro check --minimumSeverity hint && tsc --noEmit -p worker && tsc --noEmit -p test/roadmap-worker && tsc --noEmit -p test/roadmap
scripts.build:harness: npm run build --workspace @yawelo-idle/web && astro build && astro build --config astro.holding.config.ts
